s: September 29, 2022 - Chain store guppies have bad genetics and guppies in general are very sensitive. I bought six females only two survived and her sister today died due to being egg bound. Doesn't help that the netters have a habit of over stressing the fish and smooshing them against the glass. My advice is buy females and males till you have a healthy group and then allow them to populate themselves, add hiding places, live plants.
